title: SkillBridge: Cost-Aware Diagnosis and Repair of Cross-OS Compatibility Defects in Agent Skills
title_zh: SkillBridge：面向智能体技能跨操作系统兼容性缺陷的成本感知诊断与修复
abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly reuse executable capabilities through skills, but a skill that works on one OS may fail on another because OS assumptions are spread across guide text, scripts, metadata, install contracts, and local entrypoints. Diagnosing such failures by running every skill on every OS is expensive: many executions spend model tokens, runner time, and review effort before revealing whether the failure is truly OS-related. We present SkillBridge, a contract-based workflow with three stages: static analysis, dynamic validation, and repair. SkillBridge first screens 3,270 skill-target-OS cases, covering 1,090 skills across Linux, macOS, and Windows, to find OS-sensitive contract evidence. It then runs dynamic tasks and root-cause review on selected cases to confirm whether a failure is caused by an OS assumption, and repairs the contract field that caused the failure, such as guide text, package scripts, dependencies, or platform declarations. Repair raises the reviewer-judged target-task pass rate from 30.6% to 38.4%, a gain of 7.8 percentage points. A retrospective Linux/macOS budget analysis further shows the efficiency effect: SkillBridge reaches 38 confirmed OS issues with 185 dynamic validations, where uniform random selection would require about 865 validations in expectation.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通过技能（skill）复用可执行能力，但使用指南、脚本、元数据、安装契约和本地入口中的操作系统假设，可能导致同一技能在不同平台上表现不一致。逐一运行所有技能与操作系统的组合，会消耗大量模型 token、执行时间和人工审核资源。SkillBridge 提出基于契约的三阶段流程：静态分析、动态验证和修复。该方法先在 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 上对 1,090 个技能对应的 3,270 个技能—目标操作系统组合进行静态筛查，找出与操作系统相关的线索；再对选定组合执行任务并审查根因，确认失败是否由操作系统假设引起；最后修复导致失败的契约字段，如指南文本、软件包脚本、依赖项或平台声明。修复后，经评审判定的目标任务通过率从 30.6% 提升至 38.4%，提高 7.8 个百分点。对 Linux 和 macOS 的回顾性预算分析还显示，SkillBridge 仅用 185 次动态验证便确认了 38 个操作系统相关问题，而均匀随机抽样预计需要约 865 次验证。
key_points_zh: 将分散在指南、脚本、依赖项和平台声明中的操作系统假设作为诊断线索，覆盖三个操作系统上的 3,270 个技能—平台组合。
用静态分析确定优先验证对象，再通过任务执行与根因审查区分操作系统兼容性缺陷和其他失败。
针对根因修复契约字段后，目标任务通过率从 30.6% 升至 38.4%，提高 7.8 个百分点。
在 Linux 和 macOS 的回顾性分析中，确认 38 个问题仅需 185 次动态验证；均匀随机抽样预计需要约 865 次。
